features.name: Pierce's Park
features.description: Pierce's Park is the compact interactive rain-garden park behind the Rita Rossi Colwell Center, with sculptures, a musical fence, willow tunnel, native planting and a close connection to the National Aquarium.

details.positionQuality: Pierce's Park rain gardens behind the Rita Rossi Colwell Center

details.imageAuthor: Baltimore Heritage from Baltimore, MD, USA
details.imageAlt: Pierce's Park at Baltimore Waterfront Promenade

features.name: Broadway Pier
features.description: Broadway Pier is the public Fell's Point pier at the foot of South Broadway, extending from the historic Broadway Square and Thames Street waterfront into Baltimore Harbor.

details.positionQuality: Broadway Pier at the foot of South Broadway in Fell's Point
details.coordinateSource: Wikimedia Commons photograph GPS reviewed against Baltimore City municipal-pier records
details.imageAuthor: Eden, Janine and Jim from New York City
details.imageAlt: Broadway Pier at Baltimore Waterfront Promenade

features.name: Mr. Trash Wheel
features.description: Mr. Trash Wheel is the solar- and current-powered trash interceptor stationed where Jones Falls enters Baltimore Harbor, visible from the public promenade near Pier Six and Harbor East.

details.positionQuality: Public promenade viewpoint of Mr. Trash Wheel at the Jones Falls outlet
details.coordinateSource: Wikimedia Commons photograph GPS reviewed against Waterfront Partnership water-quality monitoring

details.imageAlt: Mr. Trash Wheel at Baltimore Waterfront Promenade
